info.name: FitCore Gym Management API
info.description:
All FitCore microservice APIs through the API gateway.

1. Set the collection variable **baseUrl** to `http://<EC2-1 public IP>:8000`.
2. Set **adminEmail** / **adminPassword** to the SEED_ADMIN_* values from your EC2-1 `.env`.
3. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Tokens and ids are saved automatically.

Roles: admin, trainer, member. Folder 13 deletes the demo data, so run it last.

item.name: 1. Auth - registration & login
item.description: Registration service (sign-up, staff accounts) and Login service (JWT).

request.description: Public sign-up. The role is always "member"; sending "role" is rejected.
The first admin is created from SEED_ADMIN_* environment variables when registration-service starts.
Only admins can create trainer or admin accounts.
Gateway checks the health of every microservice.

item.name: 2. Users - registration service
item.description: Admin user management and self-service profile updates.

item.name: 3. Membership plans - membership service
item.description: Plan catalogue. Reading is public; changes are admin-only.

item.name: 5. Payments - payment service
item.description: Paying calls membership-service to activate the membership.
